recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（karyogram）：染色體依長度、著絲點位置與帶紋排成 1–22 對加上性染色體，此圖可見一條 X 與一條 Y，各對同源染色體帶紋與長度大致一致、marker 欄空白，外觀為正常男性核型 46,XY。
features: G-banded karyogram with chromosomes paired and ordered 1-22 by length, centromere position and banding pattern
Sex chromosomes: one X and one Y, indicating a male karyotype
Homologs appear matched in length and banding at this relatively high band resolution; no obvious deletion, translocation or extra chromosome
Marker (mar) slot empty; total count appears to be 46
Several chromosomes are bent or overlapped, which can obscure subtle rearrangements
describe_en: This is a G-banded karyogram from a cultured bone marrow aspirate, not a morphologic image. Chromosomes are arranged in pairs 1 through 22 by size, centromere position and banding pattern, with one X and one Y chromosome. The homologous pairs appear concordant in length and banding without a visible numerical or structural abnormality, and the marker slot is empty, so this cell appears to be a normal male karyotype, 46,XY. A final report requires analysis of at least 20 metaphases and correlation with morphology, because a normal karyotype does not exclude cryptic abnormalities detectable only by FISH or molecular testing.
